ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity cream/white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-brown pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous regions on lateral lobes, bounded by dense low-intensity pigmentation along the trailing edges and median notch. Widespread low-intensity mottling and punctate spots are visible within the high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (1-5 pixels) along the trailing boundary, exhibiting extreme jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature transitioning to a distinct concave sweep along the trailing edge towards the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast yellow-orange pixel clusters localized primarily within the black pigmented regions bordering the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned dark linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white ventral surface, most prominent on the lateral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and significant irregular tissue loss or jaggedness at both the left and right distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric distribution of black pigmentation, with more concentrated dark spotting on the trailing edge of the right lobe compared to the left.
